newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Stronger European feeds start quietly.
newsitem.headline: Stronger European feeds start quietly.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market started quietly this morning with sellers offering South American soymeal pellets $4 to $9 higher on the back of last night's sharply higher Chicago soymeal futures close.
Most other products were quoted unchanged to $2 up in sympathy with soymeal. No trades were reported during the early stages of the market.

"The strong fluctuations on Chicago and a stronger dollar kept most buyers sidelined early, waiting to see whether Chicago futures would rise further or follow Project A's slightly easier trend," one broker said.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
